metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: HTML rendering, session naming, and workflow helpers.

plugins.name: to-html
plugins.description: HTML rendering for Claude Code. `/to-html` toggles it on; substantive replies render as a self-contained artifact with a TL;DR, a concept map (mermaid to SVG with click-to-section, zoom, pan), a reading-order stepper, in-page search, and a settings gear. Quiet by default.

plugins.name: sesh
plugins.description: Auto-names Claude Code sessions based on conversation context. Silent UserPromptSubmit hook that injects a one-time naming instruction after a few user messages.
